feedback.end: Ponds are small bodies of water found all over the world.

instruction.text: Do you know what a pond looks like? Select different parts of the habitat to learn more.

hint.text: A habitat is an animal’s home. It can be large like a group of mountains or small like a pond.
hint.label: Habitat

feedback.correct: Ponds are filled up with water from streams, the rain or even garden hoses!
Pond habitats are found all over the UK. For example, in parks, the countryside and even our own gardens!

correct.text: Ponds are often surrounded by many plants. They are perfect for small amphibious creatures (animals that live on land and in water).
correct.sound: Ponds are often surrounded by many plants. They are perfect for small amphibious creatures, (animals that live on land and in water).

instruction.text: Which photo shows a pond? Select the correct picture.

feedback.correct: In healthy ponds, the plants clean the water!
